blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Emoji are widely treated as compact affective tokens whose meaning is summarised by a single sentiment score. We argue that this picture is incomplete. From a corpus of 16{,}575 English tweets and a per-emoji metric we call \emph{stability delta} (within-class minus between-class cosine similarity of sentence embeddings), we show that emojis used in tightly clustered topical contexts also exhibit \emph{more} polarised crowd-sourced sentiment, not less. Validated against the Kralj Novak et al.\ (2015) sentiment lexicon, the central correlation is Spearman $ρ= +0.361$ (Holm $p = 0.015$, 95\% bootstrap CI $[+0.10, +0.59]$); against the independent Ferré et al.\ (2025) Spanish 13-emotion ratings, $ρ= +0.509$ ($p = 0.0003$). The result survives permutation testing, BCa bootstrap, leave-one-out jackknife, partial correlation controlling for emoji frequency, and Holm correction across a four-test family. Topical coherence and affective dispersion are distinct dimensions of emoji meaning. As a downstream check we report leakage-free five-fold cross-validation results for sarcasm classification on the Emoji Sarcasm Dataset; all three baselines (a gated multimodal architecture, fine-tuned BERTweet features, and fine-tuned RoBERTa features) score above 0.97 macro F1, indicating the dataset has saturating emoji-label cues. We frame the classifier as supporting evidence rather than the contribution.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The stance a person holds towards a topic comes through in the affect they convey. In speech, facial expressions, gestures, and prosody carry much of that affective load. Text strips those channels away. Emoji have evolved as a compensatory device: small graphical signals that re-introduce paralinguistic cues into written discourse. What started as decoration has become a meaningful linguistic tool.
blocks.zh: 一个人对一个主题所持的立场在它们所传达的影响中得到了体现。 在言语中,面部表情,手势,和道具中,携带了大部分的感人负载. 文字把那些渠道剥去。 Emoji作为一个补偿设备演化而来:小的图形信号,将抛语提示重新注入到书面话语中. 作为装饰而开始的,已经成为了有意义的语言工具.

blocks.en: Structural evidence that this evolution is systematic comes from the corpus itself. In the Emoji Sarcasm Dataset (ESD) Subramanian et al. (2019) , 58.3% of emojis appear at the end of tweets, 28.5% in the middle, and only 13.2% at the start, replicating the sentence-final dominance reported for WhatsApp Sampietro (2020) and instant messaging Garrison et al. (2011) at social-media scale.
blocks.zh: 这种演化是系统性的结构性证据来自本体本身. 在"Emoji Sarcasm Dataset (ESD) Subramanian等 (2019)"中,58.3%的emojis出现在微博的结尾,28.5%出现在中间,只有13.2%在开头,复制了WhatsApp Sampietro(2020)和即时消息Garrison等在社交媒体规模上报道的句子-最终主导.

blocks.en: A monotonic sentiment gradient runs from VADER Hutto and Gilbert (2014) compound score + 0.267 +0.267 at the start position to − 0.018 -0.018 at the end, and substitutive function rates, where the emoji replaces a terminal sentiment word rather than decorating existing text, rising from 76.5% (start) to 91.6% (end), consistent with the affective-punctuation account Provine (1993) ; Robus et al. (2020) . This structural regularity sharpens the central question: if emoji placement follows clear pragmatic conventions, why do topical coherence and affective consistency dissociate?
blocks.zh: 单调情绪梯度从VADER Hutto和Gilbert(2014年)复合得分+0.267+0.267在起步位置到−0.018-0.018在起步位置,而代位函数率则取而代之,其中emoji取代了终端情绪词而不是去装饰已存在的文本,从76.5%(起步)上升到91.6%(结束),这与Provine(1993年);Robus等人(2020年)。 这种结构规律性使中心问题更加突出:如果按明确务实的公约安排“emoji”方案,为什么专题一致性和情感一致性不相干?

blocks.en: Most computational approaches treat each emoji as a token with a fixed affective scalar, often a single sentiment score in [ − 1 , + 1 ] [-1,+1] . That representation collapses a richer structure. We argue, and provide empirical evidence, that an emoji’s meaning unfolds along at least two independent axes: a topical axis (does the emoji co-occur with consistent textual content) and an affective axis (does the emoji evoke a consistent emotional response). The two axes are commonly assumed to align. They do not.
blocks.zh: 多数计算方法将每个emoji当作一个有固定的活塞活塞的符号,往往在[− 1,+ 1] [1,+1]中有一个单一的情绪分. 这种代表性瓦解了更丰富的结构。 我们提出并提供了经验证据,认为一个emoji的含义至少在两个独立轴线上展开:一个主题轴线(emoji的同纹物内容一致)和一个影响轴线(emoji引起一致的情感反应). 通常假定两轴对齐. 他们没有。

We define the stability delta of an emoji as the difference between within-class and between-class mean cosine similarity of sentence embeddings of the surrounding text. Higher delta means an emoji appears in textually more coherent contexts. blocks.en: Both findings survive a battery of robustness checks: permutation tests, BCa bootstrap intervals, leave-one-out jackknife, partial correlation controlling for emoji frequency, and Holm correction over the family of tests. The two correlations come from different methodologies, different languages, and different annotator populations, yet point in the same direction.

blocks.en: We then ask whether multimodal fusion of text, emoji, and structural features improves a downstream sarcasm classifier on ESD. Under leakage-free five-fold cross-validation, our gated architecture (GEMA) reaches macro F1 0.985, BERTweet feature extraction with logistic regression reaches 0.974, and RoBERTa with logistic regression reaches 0.991. All three sit above 0.97, indicating that ESD has surface-level emoji-label correlations strong enough to saturate any reasonable classifier. We therefore frame the classifier as a supporting application rather than the contribution of this paper.
blocks.zh: 然后我们问,文本、emoji和结构特征的多模式融合是否改善了ESD上下游的讽刺分类器。 在无渗漏的五倍交叉验证下,我们的闸口建筑(GEMA)达到宏F1 0.985,BERTweet地物提取与物流回归达到0.974,而RoBERTa的物流回归达到0.991。 三者都坐落在0.97上方,表明ESD的表面水平的emoji-label关联性足够强,足以饱和任何合理的分类器. 因此,我们把分类程序确定为一个支持性应用程序,而不是本文件的贡献。

blocks.en: The paper is organised as follows. Section 2 reviews related work. Section 3 describes the corpus and external resources. Section 4 formalises the stability delta and the validation battery. Section 5 presents results, including external validation and the application to sarcasm classification. Section 6 discusses implications. Section 7 concludes.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Sampietro (2020) showed that around 55% of emoji in WhatsApp messages occupy sentence-final position, suggesting they often function as affective punctuation. Robus et al. (2020) found via eye-tracking that sentence-final emoji slow first-pass reading times, consistent with emoji acting as integrative cues rather than decoration. Garrison et al. (2011) reported similar placement patterns in instant messaging. Beyond placement, Wijeratne et al. (2017) demonstrated that emoji similarity derived from sense-disambiguated definitions correlates with human judgement.
blocks.zh: Sampietro(2020年)显示,WhatsApp消息中约55%的emoji占据了句子-最终位置,暗示它们经常作为有感情的平分功能. Robus等人(2020年)通过眼睛跟踪发现,句子-最终的emoji慢了第一次通过阅读时间,这与emoji作为融合提示而不是装饰一致. Garrison等人(2011年)报告了在即时通讯中的类似投放模式。 除了安放之外,Wijeratne等人(2017年)还表明,由感同身受的定义产生的情感相似性与人类判断相关。

blocks.en: At social-media scale, sentence-final dominance holds with a substantial effect: a chi-square test on the ESD Twitter partition yields χ 2 = 4039.03 \chi^{2}=4039.03 , p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} , Cramér’s V = 0.494 V=0.494 for the association between emoji position and sarcasm label. Prior placement studies focused on structural distributions Sampietro (2020) ; Garrison et al. (2011) ; Robus et al. (2020) ; we additionally show that sentiment varies monotonically with position and that substitutive function rates increase from start to end placements, establishing that where an emoji sits predicts its pragmatic role as reliably as which emoji it is.

blocks.en: Kralj Novak et al. (2015) aggregated 1.6 million tweet-level annotations from 83 annotators into per-emoji probability distributions over (negative, neutral, positive) labels and a derived sentiment score. The lexicon underpins much of the downstream emoji sentiment literature. Recent work by Ferré et al. (2025) extends this to a 13-emotion discrete annotation database for 112 emojis, rated by 763 Spanish speakers. Czestochowska et al. (2022) crowd-sourced one-word descriptions for 1,289 emojis without textual context, providing an independent ambiguity benchmark.
blocks.zh: Kralj Novak等人(2015年)从83位注解家到(负面的,中性的,正的)标签上的每个emoji概率分布和所衍生的情绪分数,总计160万个微博级别注解. 词典支撑了下游大部分的emoji情绪文献. Ferré等人最近的工作。 (2025年) 将此扩展为112个emojis的13-emotion离散注释数据库,被763名西班牙语者评为. Czestochowska 等 (2022) 为1,289个没有文字上下文的emojis提供众包一字描述,提供了一个独立的模糊度基准.

blocks.en: Subramanian et al. (2019) introduced the Emoji Sarcasm Dataset and a BiGRU baseline using GloVe and emoji2vec features, reporting up to 0.991 accuracy on the Twitter partition under a single 60/20/20 split. Sukhavasi and Dondeti (2024) report comparable accuracy with parallel TF-IDF and emoji-vector pipelines fused into an LSTM-BERT classifier. Helal et al. (2024) and Vitman et al. (2023) show that contextual encoders such as RoBERTa with auxiliary emotion or sarcasm pre-training reach state-of-the-art F1 on harder benchmarks like Mustard, iSarcasmEval, and SemEval-2018 Task 3.
blocks.zh: Subramanian等 (2019年)采用了使用GloVe和emoji2vec特性的Emoji Sarcasm Dataset和BiGRU基线,在一款160/20/20分机下的推特分区上报告精度高达0.991. Sukhavasi和Dondeti(2024年)报告说,与平行的TF-IDF和emoji-vector管连接成LSTM-BERT分类器的可比较准确性。 Helal等人(2024年)和Vitman等人(2023年)显示,背景编码器如有辅助情感或讽刺前期训练的RoBERTA在芥末,iSarcasmEval,和SemEval-2018任务3等更硬的基准上达到了最先进的F1.

blocks.en: Cross-lingual analyses by Barbieri et al. (2016) and others have noted that emoji usage shifts across time and platform, hinting that emoji meaning has structure beyond a single scalar. Work on context-free ambiguity Czestochowska et al. (2022) treats meaning variability as a property to measure rather than to summarise. To our knowledge, no prior work has explicitly tested whether topical and affective coherence dissociate at the emoji level. That is the gap this paper addresses.
blocks.zh: Barbieri等人(2016年)等人的跨文化分析指出,emoji的使用在时间和平台上都有所变化,暗示了emoji的含义具有超越单一scalar的结构. Czestochowska等人(2022年)关于无上下文模糊性的工作将可变性视为一种可以衡量的财产,而不是可以概括的财产。 据我们所知,以前的工作没有明确检验在emoji一级是否与专题性和情感一致性无关。 这就是本文件提到的空白。

blocks.en: We use the Emoji Sarcasm Dataset Subramanian et al. (2019) as the primary corpus. The Twitter partition contains 16,859 tweets, each containing at least one emoji and labelled binary for sarcasm. After English filtering, 16,587 tweets remain; after emoji normalisation and primary-emoji extraction, the final analytical corpus contains 16,575 tweets. Retaining emojis with at least 15 occurrences leaves 62 emojis covering 15,569 embedded tweets. The analytical corpus is 38.06% sarcastic.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Pre-processing
blocks.zh: 4.1 预处理

blocks.en: Each tweet is lowercased and stripped of URLs, @mentions , and hashtag symbols (the underlying word is kept). Unicode emoji characters are replaced with whitespace to produce clean_text , which has all emoji removed and serves as the input to all downstream NLP components, including VADER scoring and sentence embedding. A separate emoji extraction pass operates on the original raw text: skin-tone modifiers (U+1F3FB through U+1F3FF) and Variation Selector-16 (U+FE0F) are stripped so presentation variants map to the same canonical form. The English filter retains tweets with at least 85% ASCII alphabetic characters, removing 272 non-English tweets from the 16,859 raw inputs.
blocks.zh: 每个推特都小写并被剥去URL、@mentions和标签符号(下面的词被保留). Unicode emoji字符被替换为白空间来生成 clean_text ,它所有emoji被去除,并作为所有下游NLP组件的输入,包括VADER分数和句子嵌入. 一个单独的emoji取出口卡在原始原始文本上运行: 皮肤-通体修饰剂(U+1F3FB通过U+1F3FF)和Variation Selectioner-16(U+FE0F)被剥去,因此呈现变体映射到同一种犬形. 英文过滤器保留了至少85%的ASCII字母字符的微博,从16,859个原始输入中删除了272个非英文微博.

blocks.en: 4.2 Emoji Placement Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 爱莫吉安置分析

blocks.en: Each tweet in the Twitter partition is classified by the position of its first emoji as start , middle , or end based on its relative location within the tweet, using the emoji library Kim and Kevin Wurster et al. Second, the compression effect is visible for high-frequency emojis.
Tokens appearing in thousands of tweets rather than tens show more muted

A rarely used emoji that appears almost exclusively in one register will track the sentiment of that register closely regardless of position; a high-frequency emoji used promiscuously across registers will average over them, flattening the positional gradient.

blocks.en: This token-level heterogeneity directly motivates the stability delta analysis that follows. Aggregate placement statistics capture the population-level gradient, but individual emoji behaviour is modulated by how topically coherent the contexts in which each symbol is deployed actually are. Where an emoji sits predicts its sentiment as reliably as which emoji it is at the population level; at the token level, that predictive power depends on the topical range of the emoji’s typical usage, which is, the very quantity that stability delta is designed to measure.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The headline result is that stability delta correlates positively, not negatively, with affective dispersion. An emoji used in textually concentrated contexts also evokes a wider rather than narrower spread of crowd-sourced affect. We emphasise the agreement between two methodologically dissimilar resources: Kralj Novak’s English tweet-level sentiment annotations Kralj Novak et al. (2015) and Ferré’s Spanish discrete-emotion Likert ratings Ferré et al. (2025) . Different annotators, different languages, different rating instruments, same direction.
blocks.zh: 头条结果是,稳定三角洲与生动分散呈正比而非负比关系。 在文字集中的场合中使用的emoji也引起更广泛的而非更窄的众源影响。 我们强调两种不同方法的资源之间达成的协议: Kralj Novak的英文微博情绪说明 Kralj Novak 等 (2015)和 Ferré’s 西班牙离散-情绪相克收视率 Ferré 等 (2025). 不同的注释者,不同的语言,不同的评级仪器,相同的方向.

blocks.en: Two interpretations are compatible with the data and we cannot fully separate them here. The first is that high-stability emojis tend to occupy specific cultural niches with strong affective valence (the fire emoji in praise contexts, the collision emoji in dramatic announcements) and the same niche supports both positive and negative affective use. The second is that crowd-sourced affective annotations are themselves polarised when an emoji has a clear cultural role, because annotators read the role rather than rate a neutral averaged perception. Either way, the practical implication is the same: representing emoji affect with a single sentiment scalar collapses the structure that the data actually carry.
blocks.zh: 两种解释与数据是相容的,我们不能在这里将它们完全分开。 其一,高稳定性的emojis往往占据有强烈的有影响价值的特定文化优势(在赞美语境中的"火"emoji,在戏剧性公告中的"相撞"emoji),而同一种优势支持正反两个有影响性的使用. 其二,当一个emoji具有明显的文化角色时,众生来源的感动性说明本身是两极分化的,因为注释者读取这个角色而不是评分中性平均感知. 无论哪种方式,实际含义都是一样的:代表emoji以单一的情绪 scalar 来影响数据实际所携带的结构.

blocks.en: The placement results establish that emoji use is far from arbitrary at the structural level. End-placement dominates at 58.3% with Cramér’s V = 0.494 V=0.494 linking position to sarcasm label - a medium-to-large effect by conventional standards Cohen (1988) , and substitutive function reaches 91.6% for end-placed emojis, confirming that trailing emojis replace, rather than decorate, a concluding sentiment word. This structural regularity makes the semantic finding more striking, not less: even within the set of end-placed, substitutive emojis, the most pragmatically constrained subgroup - topical coherence (stability delta) and affective consistency (Kralj Novak variance) dissociate. The Cramér’s V = 0.196 V=0.196 for position versus VADER label, and the 5.5 percentage-point polarity alignment gap between sarcastic and non-sarcastic tweets, jointly suggest that emoji-text sentiment mismatch is a real but weak global signal; position mediates part of that mismatch, but neither position nor mismatch alone accounts for sarcasm in this corpus. Single-scalar sentiment representations conflate these dimensions; the stability delta and the placement gradient together point toward multi-axis emoji representations as a productive direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 安置结果确定,在结构层面,使用爱莫吉远远不是任意的。 最终安置占了58.3%,Cramér的V=0.494 V=0.494 将位置与讽刺标签联系起来 — — 根据常规标准Cohen(1988年)是中到大效果,替代功能为91.6%,证实后排的emoji取代而不是装饰一个结论情感词。 这种结构规律性使语义学的发现更加引人注目,而不是更少:即使在最终设置的一组代用语义中,最务实地受限制的分组----主题一致性(稳定三角洲)和情感一致性(Kralj Novak difference)不相干。 Cramér的V=0.196 V=0.196 相对于 VADER 标签,以及讽刺与非讽刺的微博相差5.5个百分点的极性校正差距,共同暗示了emoji-text情绪不匹配是一个真实而弱的全球信号;位置调解了部分这种不匹配,但无论是立场还是不匹配,都无法单独解释此事体中的讽刺. 单层情绪将这些层面混为一谈;稳定的三角洲和放置梯度合在一起,表明多轴的情感表达是未来工作的一个富有成效的方向。

blocks.en: The negative results matter too. The Czestochowska context-free entropy and EmojiNet sense count correlations are weak and non-significant. This is consistent with our framing: Δ \Delta is a measure of contextual usage stability, not of the lexicographer’s enumeration of senses or of crowd interpretation in isolation. We treat the EmojiNet and Czestochowska results as evidence of construct distinctness rather than as failures of our metric.
blocks.zh: 负面结果也很重要。 Czestochowska 无上下文的Entropy和EmojiNet感知到的计数相关性是弱而不重要的. 这符合我们的框架: 校对:Soup 我们把“EmojiNet”和“Czestochowska”的结果视为构建独特性的证据,而不是我们衡量的失败。

blocks.en: The 5.5-point gap in alignment between sarcastic and non-sarcastic tweets is small. This complicates the long-standing intuition that emoji-text polarity inversion is the defining feature of irony. Sarcasm in ESD is signalled by surface cues (specific emoji-phrase combinations) much more than by clean polarity inversion.
blocks.zh: 讽刺性微博与非讽刺性微博对接的5.5分差距很小. 这让长期存在的直觉复杂化了,即情感文字极性倒置是讽刺的决定性特征. ESD中的讽刺用表面提示(特定的emoji-用词组合)来表示,比用干净的极性倒置来表示要多得多.

blocks.en: All three baselines exceed 0.97 macro F1. We checked our work for the obvious explanations: leakage in the centroid feature, contamination of VADER scoring by the emoji lexicon, vocabulary built on the test fold. All three are demonstrably absent. The remaining explanation is that ESD’s strong emoji-label correlations make the task near-trivial under any reasonable encoder. We therefore stop short of claiming architectural advantages for our gated fusion. A meaningful classifier comparison would require a harder benchmark such as iSarcasmEval Abu Farha et al. (2022) or SemEval-2018 Task 3 Van Hee et al. (2018) where state-of-the-art F1 sits in the 0.6 range.
blocks.zh: 所有三个基线都超过了0.97个宏F1. 我们检查了我们的工作 以明确的解释: 中间行星特征的渗出, 污染 VADER 评分 由 emoji 词典, 词汇构建在测试折叠上。 三者皆显所缺. 剩下的解释是ESD的强烈的emoji-label关联使得任务在任何合理的编码器下都接近三相. 因此,我们不再声称我们的聚变具有建筑优势。 有意义的分类比较需要更严格的基准,例如iSarcasmEval Abu Farha等人(2022年)或SemEval-2018 任务3 Van。 Hee等 (2018),最先进的F1坐落于0.6范围内.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented the stability delta, a simple per-emoji metric of textual context coherence derived from sentence embeddings, and showed that it correlates positively with two independent measures of affective dispersion: Kralj Novak (2015) sentiment variance ( ρ = + 0.361 \rho=+0.361 , Holm p = 0.015 p=0.015 ) and Ferré (2025) number of strongly evoked emotions ( ρ = + 0.509 \rho=+0.509 , p = 0.0003 p=0.0003 ). The result survives a battery of robustness checks. Topical coherence and affective valence are distinct dimensions of emoji meaning; representing emoji affect with a single sentiment scalar discards real structure. We provide a leakage-free five-fold evaluation of multimodal sarcasm classification on ESD as supporting context, and observe that the dataset is too easy to differentiate architectures meaningfully. Code, data-processing scripts, and validation outputs are provided as anonymised supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了稳定性三角洲,这是从句子嵌入中得出的文字上下文一致性的简单每个emoji度量,并表明它与两个影响分散的独立度量有积极的关系: Kralj Novak(2015) 情绪差异( ^ + 0. 361\rho → 0.361, Holm p = 0.015 p = 0.015) 和 Ferré(2025) 强烈激起的情绪数量( ^ + 0. 509\rho 0. 509, p = 0.0003 p = 0.0003 ) , 其结果延续了强力检查的电池。 主题一致性和有影响的价值是emoji含义的不同维度;代表emoji以单一的情感 scalar来影响真实的结构. 我们提供一种无渗漏的五倍评价,对ESD进行多模式讽刺分类,作为辅助背景,并观察到数据集过于容易对架构进行有意义的区分. 代码、数据处理脚本和验证产出作为匿名补充材料提供。

blocks.en: Three directions are most promising. First, validation of stability delta on harder sarcasm benchmarks (iSarcasm, SemEval-2018 Task 3) where the affective-vs-topical distinction may yield architectural gains. Second, extension of the analysis to multi-platform timestamped corpora to test temporal generalisation properly. Third, exploring whether emoji embeddings learned with explicit affective-topical disentanglement (two heads, one for context, one for affect) outperform single-vector representations on downstream affective tasks.
blocks.zh: 三个方向最有希望。 首先,在更硬的讽刺基准(iSarcasm,SemEval-2018 Task 3)上验证稳定性三角洲,其中的活性-vs-主题区分可能会产生建筑收益. 第二,将分析延伸至多平台被打上时间戳的"蝎子",以正确测试时间通化. 第三,探索emoji嵌入在明显有影响-专题分解(两个头,一个是上下文,一个是影响)的情况下所学到的在下游有影响的任务上是否超越了单媒介的表示.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The 62-emoji panel is small and the Kralj Novak sample at n = 59 n=59 is at the lower end of what supports rank correlation analysis, despite our best efforts at robust inference. The Ferré match is biased toward lower-stability emojis (Section 5 ), so the ρ = + 0.509 \rho=+0.509 is a conservative estimate. We work in English on the topical side and rely on Spanish-rated emotions for one of the two external resources; cross-cultural transfer is an open question. We do not include a temporal analysis: a separate exploratory comparison between ESD Twitter and a 2025 BlueSky scrape was confounded by a 65-fold size imbalance, platform effects, and register differences (BlueSky data was seeded from #sarcasm hashtags). We mention temporal drift only as future work.
blocks.zh: 62-emoji面板很小,Kralj Novak在n=59n=59的样本处于支持等级关联分析的下端,尽管我们在强力推论方面尽了最大努力. Ferré比赛偏向于低稳定性的emojis(第5节),因此  = + 0.509\rho=+0.509是一个保守的估计. 我们用英语在话题方面工作,依靠西班牙语的情感来获得两种外部资源之一;跨文化的转移是一个未决问题。 我们不包括时间分析:在ESD Twitter和2025 BlueSky scrape之间单独进行探索性比较, 我们只提到时间漂移作为今后的工作。

blocks.en: We release no new annotated corpus. The artefacts we share are derived per-emoji aggregates in CSV and JSON, so a formal datasheet Gebru et al. (2021) does not apply. These aggregates are structured tabular data tied to public DOI-tracked sources, in line with FAIR principles Wilkinson et al. (2016) for derived statistics.
blocks.zh: 我们没有发布新的附带说明的官司。 我们分享的工艺品在CSV和JSON中是按emoji计算得出的总量,因此一个正式的数据表Gebru等人(2021年)不适用. 这些汇总是结构化的表格数据,与公共的DOI跟踪来源相挂钩,符合FAIR原则 Wilkinson等人(2016年)的衍生统计数据.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Treating emoji affect as a single fixed score may trigger negative impacts when that score feeds into a downstream pipeline. A moderation system built this way will misread ironic intent, and the misreads will fall harder on figurative styles common in non-native and dialect varieties. A false sarcasm flag misroutes a moderation queue; a missed one lets ironic harm through. Representing topical and affective dimensions as separate axes, the change this paper recommends, narrows that failure mode.
blocks.zh: 将emoji作为单一固定分数处理可能会在分数输入下游管道时引起负面影响。 这样建立的温和制度会误读讽刺意图,而误读会更难于非本土和方言品种所常见的比喻风格. 假的讽刺旗帜误导了温和的队列;漏掉的队列让讽刺的伤害穿过. 本文建议将专题和情感维度作为单独的轴来表示,缩小了失败模式。

blocks.en: All data we analyse is public and anonymised. Usernames are stripped from any redistributed slices, and no individual users are identified. Consent is inherited from the public-API terms of the original Twitter scrape and from the open-access licences of Kralj Novak, Ferré, EmojiNet, and Czestochowska. We redistribute only derived per-emoji aggregates, never raw tweets. The Emoji Sarcasm Dataset contains offensive language typical of sarcastic discourse online; we do not curate or republish it.
blocks.zh: 我们分析的所有数据都是公开和匿名的。 用户名从任何重新分配的切片中剥去,没有识别出任何个人用户. EmojiNet和Czestochowska的公开使用许可。 我们只重新分配每个emoji的汇总数据, Emoji Sarcasm Dataset包含了讽刺性言论的典型在线语言;我们不整理或再版.

blocks.en: To evaluate the stability and significance of the primary correlations involving Kralj Novak data, we subject each relationship to a seven-test statistical battery (10,000 resamples/permutations where applicable):
blocks.zh: 为了评估涉及Kralj Novak数据的主要关联的稳定性和重要性,我们把每个关系都置于一个7个测试统计电池组(在适用的情况下,有10 000个复标/容积):

blocks.en: 1. Spearman Rank Correlation ( ρ \rho ): Evaluates monotonic relationships using both asymptotic and empirical permutation p p -values (10,000 permutations). 2. Percentile Bootstrap 95% CI: Non-parametric confidence intervals constructed over 10,000 resamples. 3. BCa Bootstrap 95% CI: Bias-corrected and accelerated confidence intervals (10,000 resamples) to adjust for skewness and acceleration in the sample distribution. 4. Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} : Serves as a rank-based sensitivity check on distributional shape and tied ranks. 5. Leave-One-Emoji-Out Jackknife: Assesses high-leverage outliers by recording the range [ ρ min , ρ max ] [\rho_{\min},\rho_{\max}] when each emoji is systematically omitted once. 6. Partial Spearman Correlation: Controls for confounding emoji frequency | T e | |T_{e}| using rank-residual analysis. 7. Holm Correction: Adjusts p p -values for family-wise error rate across the four-test family.

BCa Bootstrap 95% CI:为调整样本分布的扭矩和加速而调整的比斯校正和加速置信间隔(10,000个复标). 4. 肯德尔的"b\tau": 充当分级敏感度检查分布形状和被捆绑的分级. 5. 离开一枝小刀: 评估高杠杆值时, 记录每个emoji被系统省略一次的幅度[ $ min, $ max] 。 6. 部分Spearman关联: 利用军衔剩余分析来控制迷惑的emoji频率 T e e e e e . 7. 霍尔姆校正: 调整 p - p - 值,用于四试全取的家庭误差率。

blocks.en: The battery assumes monotonic rank relationships between variables, exchangeability of observations under the null hypothesis for permutation testing, and independence across individual emoji entries. The partial Spearman procedure additionally assumes that rank residuals on emoji frequency exhibit approximate linearity; visual inspection confirmed that minor departures from linearity were negligible relative to small- n n sample variances, which are explicitly addressed by the BCa bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 电池假设变量之间的单音阶关系,在平分测试的空假说下观测的可交换性,以及单个emoji条目的独立性. 部分Spearman程序还假定,emoji频率上残留物的分级大致具有线性;视觉检查证实,与小-n-样本差异相比,小-n-样本差异可忽略不计,这些差异由BCa靴子间隔明确处理。
